choice.basis: The y-axis is labeled 'Pumping volume (m3)' with gridlines at 10,000, 15,000, 20,000, 25,000, 30,000, 35,000, and 40,000. The May bar is the only bar with a top edge below the 10,000 gridline, appearing near the 8,000 level. All other monthly bars (Apr, Jan, Jun, Feb, Mar) have top edges well above the 10,000 gridline, with the next lowest (Jun) near 17,500. This creates a distinct visual separation between May and the rest of the data, indicating an isolated, severe drop in pumping volume.
choice.option_label: Escalate May to critical low-pumping anomaly review
